children: Iron ore prices are higher in early Asian trade. Prices are likely to stay range-bound in the near term, Baocheng Futures analysts say in a commentary. Elevated ocean freight costs and pre-holiday restocking expectations continue to support iron ore prices, they say, referring to China's week-long national holiday in October. However, high supply could put pressure on prices, they add. The most-traded iron-ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 1.1% higher at CNY727.0 a ton. (tracy.qu@wsj.com)
